text:
Ava (all-hands host): thanks everyone — quick live pulse on customer wins/losses. drop one-line signals + why we won/lost and any top asks. i'll synth and share back.

Rafael (sales): Won — fintech integration. why: predictable latency + dedicated capacity + clear SLA. Pushback: wanted commit discounts + clearer cost examples.

Marta (cx): Lost — large retailer. main reasons: compliance gaps (data residency), SSO not on their IdP, and missing SOC2 evidence. they moved to incumbent for audit trail.

Priya (product): Noted. top asks i'm hearing: faster private deploy quickstart, longer audit log retention, more granular RBAC, and pricing options for burst vs committed usage. should we reprioritize any of these?

Jordan (eng): For private quickstart we have a prototype script but it's manual and fragile. linking internal repo: https://go/repo-private-quickstart (internal). needs an ops doc and a small service wrapper.

Ava (all-hands host): can we assemble a short playbook for AE/SEs to handle pricing + compliance objections? Rafael / Sam — can you help with bullets?

Rafael (sales): yes — quick bullets for the playbook: 1) show caching/batching savings estimate; 2) run dedicated capacity TCO vs on-demand; 3) offer staged commit discounts; 4) provide customer case studies. :thumbsup:

Sam (ceo): +1. i'm available to join EMEA security-heavy pitches. also we should surface the SOC2 roadmap publicly for larger prospects.

Priya (product): i'll draft a one-pager with prioritized asks and owners. target: next wed. also proposing a single 'loss root-cause' sheet where we capture why we lost, customer asks, and blockers.

Marta (cx): i'll add the retailer postmortem and the audit notes to that sheet.

Jordan (eng): from eng perspective — the recurring blocker in wins is onboarding latency variance on very long contexts. short-term mitigation: per-customer auto-quantization profiles and tuned kernel selection. long-term: tighter compilation heuristics.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary for private-quickstart v0.2 deployed to staging at 1775551500 — logs at https://go/logs/private-quickstart (internal).

Ava (all-hands host): @Sam can you confirm sponsorship for accelerated private rollout? everyone else pls drop a single sentence item in this thread by EOD so we can turn into action items.

Rafael (sales): done — added 3 bullets to the drive: https://go/drive/wins-losses-playbook (internal).

Priya (product): assigning owners: product -> Priya, sales -> Rafael, eng -> Jordan, cx -> Marta. sync scheduled Thu 9am PT. calendar: https://calendar.link/meet (internal).

Marta (cx): quick ask — can we add a checkbox in the playbook: 'POC success criteria (latency, throughput, security controls)'? cuts back back-and-forth.

Jordan (eng): good idea. i'll open a PR with a playbook template in the repo (branch: playbook-template).

Ava (all-hands host): perfect. i'll compile notes and send follow-up with links + owners + due dates. thanks all! :partyparrot:

Priya (product): FYI i'll also capture a rollout plan for SOC2 artifacts and a 90-day roadmap for private onboarding.

Sam (ceo): appreciate it. short follow-up ask — let's make one pager customer-facing so AEs can hand it to procurement teams.

Ava (all-hands host): agreed. i'll include that in the follow-up. please flag anything missing here before EOD.
